name.description: The unique name of the {@link UiSdlChartEChartSeries} to which this series is mapped.

yAxisIndex.description: The index of the y-axis ({@link UiSdlChartEChartAxis}) that this series maps to. If none is specified, 0 will be used.

data.description:
An array of data that will be charted. Each value must be an array with two elements: [x-value, y-value], where
<x-value> is of type string (including stringified dates) and <y-value> is of type double.

title: This type represents the series part of an eCharts config.
name: UiSdlChartEChartSeries
